messages:
Priya_CS: Heads-up — Aperture Labs is greenlighting two new teams (DataOps + Legal) to go live next week. They want an onboarding playbook, throughput bump, and a short PoC to prove latency. Renewal in ~90 days. Tagging eng for capacity checks @sam_eng @jordan_se

Sam_Eng: Got it. Can you share expected traffic profile? QPS, average & peak seq len, any peak windows?

Priya_CS: Quick numbers from their telemetry: baseline ~20 QPS, they expect spikes up to ~160 QPS during batch ingests. Avg seq length for Legal summarization ~1,200 tokens; some jobs hit 4–6k tokens. Target they quoted: <300ms token latency ideally. Also called out 6 hallucinations in a 200-sample review.

Matt_Success: This is a clear expansion signal — new teams + new critical use case (legal summarization). Recommend we propose Dedicated or a short reserved bump and a training session for their Legal team (prompt engineering + hallucination mitigation). Also need an ROI/cost uplift for procurement.

Jordan_SE: Quick note on models: if they stick with redwood-llama-70b-quant we should expect GPU memory/throughput constraints at long contexts. Options: (1) increase pod count (2) enable prefix/KV caching for repeated docs (3) suggest an natively longer-context variant or chunked summarization with rerank. I can sketch the canary config. Need staging key from Priya.

Priya_CS: Sent staging key via DM. Procurement wants an architecture doc + PoC demonstrating latency under realistic load — they're worried about SLA for legal workloads.

deploy-bot: quota_alert: Aperture Labs has reached 85% of their soft hosted token quota.

Sam_Eng: Can we grant a temporary burst limit to avoid throttling during onboarding? If yes, we should include a cost estimate for their review (30d burst).

Jordan_SE: Proposed tactical playbook for Priya to present:
- 1) 90min enablement workshop for Legal (prompt templates + eval harness)
- 2) 48–72h canary with synthetic load matching 160 QPS peaks
- 3) Move to Dedicated/reserved with burst for first 30 days if PoC passes
- 4) Weekly quality checks + prompt regression alerts tied to their eval set
I'll upload a sample canary config to #eng-runtime after the meeting.

Priya_CS: Customer feedback capture: Legal team reported 6 hallucinations in 200 samples and flagged 2 latency-sensitive endpoints. They asked for sample prompt templates, a remediation plan, and an eval harness to catch regressions.

Matt_Success: I'll draft a renewal-risk + uplift proposal (include Dedicated option + 30d burst cost + enablement package). We should request a joint meeting with VP Eng + Procurement next Tue. Who can attend for technical Qs?

Sam_Eng: I can join Tue for the technical review. Jordan can lead the PoC. Priya, can you schedule and confirm attendee list?

Priya_CS: Meeting scheduled and invites sent (VP Eng, Procurement, Product Lead, Legal SME). Will include the staging key, proposed playbook, and a short summary of hallucination findings. Thanks all :pray:
